source.name: Kelme - Kelme and the AFC extend their partnership agreement for four more years
source.note: Official Technical Sponsor of AFC's major club competitions and several national-team competitions to 2029; supplies the official match balls of the Asian Cup 2027 and ACL Elite.

note: Match-ball and technical supplier; Kelme's PARADISE ball debuted for ACL Elite 2025/26 (AFC, 2025-08-14).
